class_A.name: SECTOR_INVARIANT_BASELINE
class_A.historical_v10_6_observable: first qualifying post-2026-07-28 joint ATLAS/CMS direct charm-to-tau Higgs-coupling likelihood
class_A.historical_reason: c and tau occupy different declared sectors, so a sector baseline does not cancel from y_c/y_tau.
class_A.v10_7_correction: y_c/y_tau also contains a generation-2 versus generation-3 release difference and therefore does not isolate class A.
class_A.superseding_primary_observable: first qualifying post-2026-07-29 joint ATLAS/CMS direct charm-to-muon Higgs-coupling likelihood
class_A.superseding_reason: c and mu are both generation 2, so the complete D(G2,R2) term cancels and y_c/y_mu isolates the sector functional.
class_A.rule: May use only coordinates invariant across generations inside a declared sector. Generation-varying coordinates must be assigned to class B.

class_B.name: UNIVERSAL_GENERATION_RELEASE
class_B.primary_prospective_observable: first qualifying post-2026-07-29 joint ATLAS/CMS direct charm-to-top Higgs-coupling likelihood
class_B.rule: May use generation-varying structural coordinates, but the same algebraic operator must be applied across all charged-fermion families.

reclassification_rule: Any proposed class-A functional that uses mode, generation, generation-varying v7, or another within-sector varying field is reclassified as class B before testing.

theorems.same_sector_cancellation: For a sector-invariant baseline B_s with s(c)=s(t), log(y_c/y_t)=Delta_c-Delta_t; y_c/y_t is insensitive to B_s.
theorems.same_generation_cancellation_v10_7: For a separable architecture with g(c)=g(mu)=2, log(y_c/y_mu)=F(S_up)-F(S_lepton); the generation release cancels.
theorems.v10_6_cross_sector_only_limit: Different sectors are necessary but not sufficient to isolate class A when the compared states belong to different generations.
